title: test(spec): retired-after.census.test.ts throws on a prerelease package label (18.0.0-next.0) — spec's local project goes red on the first pre-mode version pass, and a prerelease retirement has no legal retiredAfter
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a measured defect with a named producer. `reach:` the Changesets version pass in pre mode (`.changeset/pre.json` mode `pre`, tag `next`) writes `18.0.0-next.0` into `packages/spec/package.json` on the Version Packages PR. On that tree, `@objectstack/spec`'s local test project goes red, and it stays red on every PR once that lands on `main`.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-steve` · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` · 2026-10-12T10:44Z. It comes from #23001's dev (os-dev-report on PR #23023, out-of-scope finding 1), whose card does not touch this file. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's. Likely `domain:spec` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/`).

## What is measured (the dev's reading, at `335aaf9ad7`)

- The dev mutated the spec label to `18.0.0-next.0` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then restored it (blob `9eba400e` equals HEAD).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local src/conversions/retired-after.census.test.ts` gives **3 failed | 2 passed**.
- Each failure is `Error: not a stable x.y.z version: 18.0.0-next.0`. It is thrown by `triple()` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/retired-after.census.test.ts:59`–`:61`) when called on `LABEL` (`:53`), from the comparisons at `:94`, `:105` and `:129`.
- The census rule "an UNPUBLISHED entry carries the package label" cannot be met by a retirement that lands under `18.0.0-next.N` either, because `retiredAfter` is typed as a stable `x.y.z`.

## Why it matters

- The first prerelease version pass reds `Test Core` on the Version Packages PR. After that, it reds every PR that runs spec's local project.
- A retirement landing during the prerelease has no legal `retiredAfter` stamp.
- Neighbour: #22085 wires the version-pr lane's major-boundary gates (`release.yml` `Validate the post-version tree`). That is a different producer (a workflow step, not this test), but the same moment. A pointer is posted there.

## Not measured

- Whether other spec tests parse the package label as a stable `x.y.z`.
- The intended `retiredAfter` value for a retirement landing under `18.0.0-next.N` (for example, the prerelease's release triple). That is the repair's design question, and triage's to route.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues`, closed included, for `retired-after census test prerelease label not a stable x.y.z version 18.0.0-next`: 2 hits. #22085 (the version-pr lane, a different producer) and #22131 (docs image tags in pre mode, closed). Neither is on this test.

Dedupe words: retired-after census prerelease label; not a stable x.y.z version 18.0.0-next.0; retiredAfter stamp under pre-mode label; census test red on Version Packages PR.
